description: M18 Brushless ½” High Torque Impact Wrench delivers faster driving speeds and increased productivity without the hassle of a cord. A 1/2” anvil with friction ring will allow users quick and easy socket changes and the onboard LED light will provide greater visibility on the jobsite.
